verdict.rationale: Unit serves an llms.txt at its root (the probe returned HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it. It also links a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec from its docs. However, the llms.txt content in evidence is a product and capability overview rather than API-level guidance, and the markdown docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt links to or contains API reference content, markdown/agent-readable versions of the docs pages (the .md probe 404'd), an llms-full.txt or similar expanded file, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.unit.co/llms.txt # Unit
